name: psrr-dc
description: Error-amplifier contribution to PSRR at 1 kHz across full PVT: supply-to-output coupling G and differential gain A, plus the projected LDO PSRR = A*beta/|1-G|.
claim: README 'PSRR' row -- > 50 dB @ 1 kHz (stretch 60 dB) -- **amplifier contribution only**. This record substantiates the amp-level half of the budget in design/error_amp.md; the closed-loop measurement (pass device + divider + output network) is #12's and should get its own experiment slug rather than reusing this one.
analyses: meas ac gpsr10_db find vdb(vg1) at=10
meas ac gpsr100_db find vdb(vg1) at=100
meas ac gpsr1k_db find vdb(vg1) at=1k
meas ac gpsr10k_db find vdb(vg1) at=10k
meas ac gpsr100k_db find vdb(vg1) at=100k
meas ac adiff1k_db find vdb(vg2) at=1k
meas ac adiff10k_db find vdb(vg2) at=10k
meas ac adiff100k_db find vdb(vg2) at=100k

operating_conditions.load_current: N/A -- amp-level characterisation. PSRR ~= A*beta/|1-G| is load-independent to first order (Zout, ro_pass and gm_pass cancel; see the testbench header), which is exactly why the budget is carried by amp gain rather than by the pass-device topology.
operating_conditions.amp_output_load: 6.14 pF lumped -- the measured worst-case Cgg of the pfet_03v3 pass device at W = 4 mm / L = 0.28 um, ss / -40 C (sim/devchar/CONCLUSIONS.md S1)
operating_conditions.output_cap: N/A -- outside the amplifier boundary; the DR-0001 cap/ESR window is #10's and #12's to verify
operating_conditions.input_common_mode: 1.2 V (ldo_core's ratified divider: 1.8 V out from a 1.2 V reference, beta = 2/3)
operating_conditions.bias: self-biased from VDD inside the cell, so the bias branch's own supply sensitivity is included in the measured G rather than idealised away
operating_conditions.enable_state: N/A -- the 5-port interface has no enable pin
operating_conditions.output_operating_point: both instances servo'd to OUT = 2.0 V, the ~50 mA regulation point at Vin = 3.3 V
operating_conditions.spec_point: 1 kHz. 10 Hz / 100 Hz / 10 kHz / 100 kHz are extracted into the raw corner logs for context; DC is not measurable on this bench because the DC servo nulls it by construction.

psrr_ldo_1k_db.description: README PSRR row: > 50 dB @ 1 kHz (stretch 60 dB). This is the BUDGETED projection A*beta with |1-G| forced to 1, i.e. the amp must clear the spec on gain alone and the measured supply tracking is treated as unbudgeted margin (see design/error_amp.md).

adiff_1k_db.description: 50 dB PSRR needs 50 - 20*log10(2/3) = 53.5 dB of amp gain at 1 kHz. The spread floor is a harness-integrity check that the corner .lib sections and .temp actually took effect.

gpsr_1k_vv.description: supply-to-output coupling must stay inside the range where it helps rather than hurts (|1-G| <= 1)
